title: LBS-Master scene gap metrics row
description: Runtime: demand = demand_base * weather_coeff[weather].demand_{scene} * node_coeff; supply = supply_base * weather_coeff[weather].supply_{scene} * node_coeff. norm is identity on 0–100 indices, so gap = demand - supply (higher = worse shortage). Coefficients from data/static/weather_coeff.json and calendar.json. All metrics are Synthetic.
